mcu_output_screen.footnotes: Observe per-pin and aggregate current ratings. Other low-current rows marked specified by design, not production tested.
mcu_output_screen.qualification: Conditional static screening only: regulator must remain in regulation, ground drops and transient margins excluded. At VDD=2.7V the 2.3V VOH bound does not support the selected 2.5V RDSon condition.

brownout_screen.result: BOR4 cannot guarantee reset before VDD falls below 2.9V. PVD6 likewise does not guarantee detection above 2.9V, before considering interrupt latency. Do not use typical or maximum thresholds as guaranteed minimum.
brownout_screen.firmware_observation: usb_input_v15_suspend/resume check initialized/task context; resume also checks VBUS. Neither verifies MCU VDD. Reset during high suspend pulse can complete OFF only if drain was driven sufficiently low first.
brownout_screen.next_design_action: Evaluate a pin-compatible MOSFET with RDSon specified at 1.8V; minimum VDD then 2.2V under VDD-.4 bound. Still verify startup, BOR programming, reset GPIO behavior, temperature, leakage and dynamic edges. No part substitution adopted.
